name: nulnul-harness
description: Build a project-fit agent team, reuse proven skills and plugins, and evolve both the work and its improvement procedure.

interface.longDescription: Describe the outcome, not the AI architecture. nulnul harness inspects the project, reuses suitable skills and plugins, assembles the smallest useful task and meta-agent system, preserves progress, and improves both the work and its own improvement procedure behind an independent Gate.
defaultPrompt: Build this project. Find proven skills before creating new ones, and keep the setup minimal.
Turn this recurring workflow into a verified automation and improve both the work and its improvement process from real runs.
Build the smallest task and meta-agent system for this project, preserve verified progress, and require independent promotion.
